_readme: Fallback map of DraftKings draftGroupId values, keyed by season/week/slate. DraftKings' discovery listing (GET https://api.draftkings.com/draftgroups/v1/) only returns contests that are still 'Upcoming', so once a slate's games kick off its draftGroupId disappears from that listing even though /draftgroups/v1/draftgroups/{id}/draftables keeps serving it. The app tries live discovery first (app/dk_client.py:discover_draft_groups) and falls back to this file so already-started/completed slates still render. New weeks are added by 'python -m scripts.record_draft_groups', run weekly after salaries post and before the first kickoff; it only records groups found live that have salaried players. Week 2 of 2026 is missing because its slates had already started before this was set up.
